blocks.text: Screengrab from Senate of the Philippines / YouTube Dole: P25 NCR wage hike still possible if Wage Order 27 upheld in court MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Labor and Employment (Dole) on Wednesday said the additional P25 daily wage increase for Metro Manila workers can still be implemented if the courts will ultimately uphold the wage order. Dole Acting Secretary Francis Tolentino made the statement during a Senate finance committee hearing on the 2027 budget of Dole and its attached agencies. The secretary is referring to Wage Order No. 27, which, he said, is facing five court cases. Tolentino said […]...
